reason: The array is covered in grit, so brushing it clean seems useful before restarting services.
expectation: I expect to clear the solar panels so they can collect more light, though I don't know whether that will restart power immediately.

alternatives.reason: Restarting the water line also serves the goal, but restoring solar power first seems practical.

effect: Brushing the array restored the solar supply; it can now be used at the restart controls.
reaction: The result was straightforward, though I’m curious how the restart will handle the water line.
reason: The restored solar supply seems like a practical place to start bringing essential services back online.
expectation: I expect the controls to reconnect the station to solar power, though other services may still need separate steps.

alternatives.reason: The drained water line also needs restarting, but I prefer to reconnect power first.

effect: The solar restart brought the return plant back online, and it will need weeks to replace propellant lost during shutdown. The water line still needs attention.
reaction: I was surprised that some stored propellant boiled away, adding time to the return preparations.
reason: The drained water line is the only gameplay action offered and should help restore essential services.
expectation: I expect the controls to restart the water line, perhaps after its heating and thaw checks; I’m unsure whether flow will return immediately.

effect: The heating and clearance checks let the exterior line be primed and the well inlet reopened, restoring water to the tap and completing the restart.
reaction: The sequence was clear and satisfying; the line needed preparation before water could flow again.

mostWorthwhile.text: Restarting the water line was most worthwhile because the result explained how heating, clearance checks and priming restore flow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Brushing the array was a straightforward choice, but its result offered little detail beyond restoring the supply.

surprise.text: I was surprised that stored propellant had boiled away during the shutdown and would take weeks to replace.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each had a clear connection to restoring services.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the delayed return and the specimens develop; the propellant loss gave the recovery a consequence beyond simply switching systems back on.
